snapshot.name: Take camera snapshot
snapshot.description: Grab a single frame from the camera's RTSP stream and save it to a file. Falls back to a placeholder image if the stream is unavailable.

filename.name: Filename
filename.description: Absolute path where the snapshot will be written. Leave empty to auto-save under /config/www/ucams_snapshots/ and get a /local/ URL back.

get_archive.name: Get archive link
get_archive.description: Request an archive URL for a camera over a time range. The link is published on the camera's archive sensor.

entity_id.name: Camera
entity_id.description: Ucams camera entity to fetch archive for.

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: Archive start time as a Unix timestamp (UTC).
